items.title: BlackRock Inks Union Pact to Support Data Center Boom
items.summary: Investment firms are looking to new kinds of partnerships as the historic data-center construction boom strains resources, including labor.  BlackRock and its new AI infrastructure fund have signed an agreement with North America’s Building Trades Unions, which represents more than 3 million skilled construction workers in the U.S. and Canada.  Under the pact, BlackRock and its AI infrastructure fund partners—which include Microsoft and Nvidia—will share early details of their construction plans with NABTU to better staff future projects.
